This project is an Expo (React Native) mobile app migrated from a React js web project. Maintain a modern, clean, and responsive mobile UI. Use React Navigation for routing. Organize code into `components`, `screens`, and `services` folders. Use native React Native solutions for forms, HTTP requests, and validation.
